title: Goofy Ahh
blurb: Nobody can quite define goofy ahh, and the vagueness is doing useful work. It names an entire editing aesthetic compressed into a noise: cartoon-adjacent, over-compressed, aimed exclusively at things that consider themselves serious. The phrase grew out of the internet's habit of bolting 'ahh' onto any adjective. Goofy ahh, weird ahh, ugly ahh. This clip became the audio stamp for the whole genre, so drop it over a motivational speech, a gym transformation video or somebody's LinkedIn announcement, and watch the gravity drain out of the room.
origin: From the 'goofy ahh' meme wave, where cartoonish sounds get applied to overly serious clips.
